title: Merge verification — spot checks, the cumulative rule, and the contradiction alarm

acceptance_criteria.given: a base .dotbabel.json whose attestation.spot_check has an unknown key, or a rate outside 0 to 1
acceptance_criteria.then: it throws, and never falls back to the default rate

tests.name: throws on an unknown key, never silently defaulting
throws on a rate outside 0 to 1 or not a number

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request head SHA and number
acceptance_criteria.when: the spot-check roll is computed twice
acceptance_criteria.then: both rolls are the first 32 bits of sha256 of the head and the number, so the same head always gets the same answer

tests.name: derives the same roll from the same head and pull request
is the first 32 bits of sha256 of head and pull request

acceptance_criteria.given: a resolved spot-check policy, the changed paths, the CI availability, and a roll
acceptance_criteria.then: an always_paths match selects whatever the rate, an unavailable CI applies rate_when_ci_unavailable, and otherwise the roll is compared with rate

tests.name: selects an always path whatever the rate
uses rate_when_ci_unavailable when the default branch CI did not run
selects by rate when the roll is below the rate

acceptance_criteria.given: a run whose only job failed with zero steps and no runner (the billing-blocked shape), and a run where one job failed after its steps ran while a dependent job was skipped with zero steps
acceptance_criteria.then: the first is unverified and the second is red

tests.name: classifies a billing-blocked run as unverified
classifies a failed job with steps as red even when a dependent job was skipped with zero steps

acceptance_criteria.given: default-branch commits newest first and the classified runs for them, or runs that could not be read
acceptance_criteria.when: the main verification status is computed
acceptance_criteria.then: a green run verifies its commit and every older commit, newer commits are red or unverified, and unreadable runs make every commit unknown and none verified

tests.name: lets a green run verify its commit and every older commit
reports unknown, never verified, when the runs could not be read

acceptance_criteria.given: a red run, an unverified run, and a trusted current passing attestation for the head
acceptance_criteria.then: only the red run with the passing attestation is a contradiction

tests.name: is a contradiction when a real failure meets a current trusted passing attestation
is not a contradiction when the run did not verify anything

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request whose base commit carries a spot-check policy that differs from the working tree
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack spot-check runs, once with a billing-blocked latest default-branch run and twice on one head
acceptance_criteria.then: the policy comes from the base commit, a billing-blocked CI selects with ci_unavailable when a spot_check block exists, a policy that is off decides off after the one pull request read and records nothing, and both runs on one head give the same roll and the same selection

tests.name: verifies every pull request when the latest default-branch run was billing-blocked
selects nothing without a spot_check block, even when the default-branch run was billing-blocked
reads the policy from the base commit, not the working tree
gives the same answer on the same head, from a roll derived from the head

acceptance_criteria.given: a ready run receipt with phase attempts
acceptance_criteria.when: spot-check and explicit-run entries are recorded for the same pull request
acceptance_criteria.then: they go to the sibling log pr-<N>.spot-checks.json under its own strict schema, and the receipt keeps its v1 keys, its attempt numbers, its attempt cap count and its ready verdict

tests.name: records a spot-check decision as its own append-only entry
keeps spot-check entries out of the attempt count, the cap, and the ready verdict

acceptance_criteria.given: default-branch commits with a green, a red, and a billing-blocked run, or an Actions API that fails, and a repository on the project-command trust allowlist
acceptance_criteria.then: it reports the last green commit and the debt newer than it, reports unknown when the runs cannot be read, and runs the local matrix in a temporary worktree that it labels weaker than CI and removes, and says that it installed nothing without a supported lockfile

tests.name: applies the cumulative rule and reports the debt newer than the last green run
reports unknown, never verified, when the runs cannot be read
runs the matrix locally in a temporary worktree, labels it weaker than CI, and removes the worktree

acceptance_criteria.given: a merge commit whose test run failed after its steps ran, for a pull request with a trusted passing attestation, whose first parent has a green run
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack contradiction runs with --post, again when an issue already carries the marker, and for a billing-blocked run
acceptance_criteria.then: it labels the pull request and opens exactly one issue for the failing commit, opens no second issue, reads no annotation, and posts nothing for the billing-blocked run

tests.name: labels the pull request and opens one issue when a real failure contradicts a passing attestation
does not open a second issue when one already carries the marker
never treats a billing-blocked run as a contradiction

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request with a trusted passing attestation for its head
acceptance_criteria.then: it labels the pull request and opens one issue that says the run was on the same machine as the agent

tests.name: labels a pull request whose local explicit run failed against a passing attestation

acceptance_criteria.given: the parsed test workflow of this repository and of the consumer template
acceptance_criteria.then: it needs the test job, runs only on the exact condition failure() && github.event_name == 'push', holds only contents read, actions read, checks read, issues write and pull-requests write, checks out the first parent (github.event.before) with full history and no persisted credentials, and runs the contradiction command with --post

tests.name: runs the template contradiction job only after a failed push, through the published CLI
runs this repository's contradiction job only after a failed push, through the in-tree bin

acceptance_criteria.given: the published config schema
acceptance_criteria.when: a spot_check block with a rate outside 0 to 1, a bad path list, or an unknown key is validated
acceptance_criteria.then: the schema rejects it

tests.name: rejects a spot-check rate outside 0 to 1, a bad path list, or an unknown key

acceptance_criteria.given: a red run whose annotations name billing, a billing-blocked run, and a run cancelled after a job failed with steps
acceptance_criteria.then: an annotation never changes the state: the red run stays red, the never-started job is unverified through the zero-step rule alone, and the cancelled run with a failed step is red

tests.name: keeps a red run red when an annotation names billing
classifies a job that never started as unverified through the zero-step rule alone
classifies a cancelled run as red when a job had already failed after its steps

acceptance_criteria.given: a run or a jobs list that could not be read, and the newest completed default-branch run and the recent first-parent commits
acceptance_criteria.when: the run is classified, the default-branch status is computed, and CI availability is decided
acceptance_criteria.then: an unread run is unknown and never unverified, an unknown commit is debt and never verified, CI is available only when the newest completed run tested a recent commit, and CI is unknown, never available, when anything could not be read

tests.name: classifies a failed run as unknown, never unverified, when its jobs cannot be read
classifies a run that cannot be read as unknown
reports a commit whose run could not be read as unknown debt, never verified
accepts the newest completed run only when it tested a recent default-branch commit
reports CI unknown, never available, when the runs, the run or the commits cannot be read

acceptance_criteria.given: an Actions API whose jobs list for a run cannot be read
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack contradiction, main-status and spot-check read that run
acceptance_criteria.then: contradiction exits 2 and posts nothing, main-status shows the commit as unknown debt, and spot-check reports CI as unknown

tests.name: is an env error when the jobs of the run cannot be read, never a silent no
reports a commit whose run jobs cannot be read as unknown debt, never unverified
reports CI as unknown when the jobs of the newest run cannot be read

acceptance_criteria.given: a repository whose default branch is not main, and a newest completed run that tested none of the last commits
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack spot-check and main-status run without --trunk
acceptance_criteria.then: they read the default branch from gh and record it, they exit 2 when it cannot be read, and CI is unavailable when the newest completed run tested none of the recent commits

tests.name: reads the repository default branch when --trunk is not given, and records it
is an env error when the default branch cannot be read and --trunk is not given
reports CI unavailable when the newest completed run tested none of the recent commits
reads the repository default branch, and exits 2 when it cannot

acceptance_criteria.given: a head that a spot check selected while CI was unavailable, and a head that it did not select
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack spot-check runs again on each head after the CI state changes
acceptance_criteria.then: the selected head is reported selected with its first reason and marked sticky, and the head that was not selected can become selected

tests.name: keeps a selection sticky for its head after the CI state changes
lets a non-selection change when CI becomes unavailable

acceptance_criteria.given: a spot-check log with a selection of a head and later entries on the same head
acceptance_criteria.then: the first selection stands with its reason and is marked sticky, and a head that was not selected can still become selected

tests.name: reports the first selection of a head when the head is asked again
keeps a selection that a hand-written later entry says was not selected
lets a non-selection change, because only a selection is sticky

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request that renames a file out of an always_paths directory, and one whose rename list cannot be read
acceptance_criteria.then: the old path of the rename matches always_paths, and an unreadable rename list selects

tests.name: selects a pull request that renames a file out of an always_paths directory
selects when always_paths is set and the old paths of renames cannot be read

acceptance_criteria.given: a merged pull request that adds its own .dotbabel.json, a first parent with no .dotbabel.json, and a first parent whose .dotbabel.json does not parse
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack contradiction reads the trust list
acceptance_criteria.then: it reads the first parent only and never the merge commit, it uses the default OWNER list and names that source when the first parent has no config, and it exits 2 when the config does not parse

tests.name: reads the trust list from the first parent only, never from the merge commit
uses the default OWNER trust list when the first parent has no .dotbabel.json
is an env error when the first parent's .dotbabel.json does not parse

acceptance_criteria.given: a trusted passing attestation comment that was edited after it was posted
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack contradiction runs on a red run
acceptance_criteria.then: the comment still counts, and the result and the issue say that it was edited

tests.name: counts an attestation comment that was edited after it was posted, and says so

acceptance_criteria.given: a red run on a commit whose parent merged with no push run, and a red run whose first parent was already red or unreadable
acceptance_criteria.then: it checks every pull request merged back to the last green run, labels each suspect and opens one issue that names the range and every suspect, opens no new alarm when the first parent was already red, and exits 2 when the first parent's run cannot be read

tests.name: checks every pull request merged since the last green run and opens one issue that names each suspect
raises no new alarm when the first parent's run was already red
is an env error when the first parent's run cannot be read

acceptance_criteria.given: first-parent history from a failing commit and the commits with a green run
acceptance_criteria.then: it runs from the failing commit back to the last green commit, not included, and stops at the bound with bounded true when no green run is found

tests.name: walks back from the failing commit to the last green commit, not including it
keeps the failing commit even when an older run of it was green
stops at the bound when no green run is found, and says it stopped

acceptance_criteria.given: in GitHub Actions, a closed matching issue that the workflow opened, and a closed matching issue that another user opened
acceptance_criteria.then: it reopens the workflow's issue with a comment and says so, and it ignores the other user's issue and opens a new one

tests.name: reopens a closed issue that the workflow opened, and says so
ignores a matching issue that someone other than the workflow opened, in CI

acceptance_criteria.given: a repository that is not on the project-command trust allowlist, and a default-branch tip whose dependency install fails
acceptance_criteria.then: without trust or --allow-project-commands it exits 2 before it runs anything, and a failed install gives the result unknown, never fail

tests.name: refuses --local without project-command trust, before it runs anything
reports a failed dependency install as unknown, never as a failing matrix

acceptance_criteria.given: the lockfiles present in a checkout, and the install list of the explicit path in commands/merge-pr.md
acceptance_criteria.then: they come from one table that matches /merge-pr (npm ci, pnpm i --frozen-lockfile, yarn --immutable, go mod download, uv sync), and no lockfile gives no install

tests.name: installs from the first JavaScript lockfile, then go.sum, then uv.lock
installs nothing without a supported lockfile
uses the same install table as the explicit path of /merge-pr

acceptance_criteria.given: a recording run that answers or fails each gh and git call
acceptance_criteria.then: every call is an argv array, a run is classified from its jobs and never from an annotation, an unread value stays unknown, the trust list never falls back to another revision, and in CI only the workflow's issue counts

tests.name: reads the jobs of any other run, and never an annotation
is unknown when the run or its jobs cannot be read, or the jobs list is incomplete
adds the old path of each renamed file to the changed paths
throws, never falling back, when the revision cannot be read or its config does not parse
reopens a closed issue with a comment, and accepts only the workflow's issue in CI

acceptance_criteria.given: a failing commit, its range, and its suspects
acceptance_criteria.then: one issue names the failing commit, the range and every suspect, and lists the possible causes in sentences of 25 words or fewer, the merged tree among them

tests.name: renders one issue for the failing commit with the range and every suspect
lists the possible causes in short sentences, the merged tree among them

acceptance_criteria.given: commands/merge-pr.md and its generated copies
acceptance_criteria.when: the spot-check, explicit-run and debt steps are read
acceptance_criteria.then: any non-zero spot-check exit stops and is never not selected, the explicit result is recorded in step 6, only a real failure raises the alarm, a gate that did not run raises none, and a non-zero main-status exit has an instruction

tests.name: merge-pr: the roll is not re-rolled, and an unreadable policy stops
merge-pr: the explicit run's result is recorded where the explicit run happens
merge-pr: only a real failure raises the alarm; a gate that did not run raises none
merge-pr: says what to do on a non-zero main-status exit
merge-pr: the generated copies carry the spot check and the alarm
